WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
),
returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, -r.refund_net AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, round(sum(amount), 2) AS net_sales
FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM returns)
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period ORDER BY fiscal_period
